name: super-productivity-google-material-3-themes
description: Google Material 3 (Material You) Theme Suite for Super Productivity

scripts.test: node scripts/validate-theme.js google-material-3.css google-material-3-sage.css google-material-3-coral.css google-material-3-lavender.css google-material-3-monochrome.css
scripts.preview: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let f=req.url==='/'?'preview.html':req.url.slice(1); if(fs.existsSync(f)){ res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':f.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':'text/html'}); fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(3000, ()=>console.log('Preview server running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Super Productivity Community
